title: Campaigns go out as Resend broadcasts, so they never use up the 100 emails a day that sign-in links and reminders need

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-11-18 (Daniel picked option A): campaign sends move to Resend Broadcasts on the Marketing Pro plan; Transactional stays on Free.

detail:
Daniel's Resend usage page (2026-11-18) shows Transactional on Free (100 a day; 201/100 that day) and Marketing on Pro (unlimited broadcasts, 5,000 contacts). An Email Studio campaign queued one outbox email per person on the Transactional plan, so the 00:00 UTC drains spent the day's allowance and later sign-in links, reminders and DMs were refused or failed (EMAIL-060). Fix, behind EMAIL_BROADCASTS_ENABLED: sendCampaignNow runs the same send gate, then lib/email-studio/broadcast.ts makes a per-campaign Resend segment, imports the allowed people (CSV upsert, never mapping `unsubscribed`, with a signed manage_url property), waits for the import and sends one broadcast. The footer Unsubscribe is Resend's own placeholder; a Resend-side opt-out (contact.updated) becomes a root-Space unsubscribe suppression in the webhook, never a global one. A re-run finds the broadcast named campaign:<id> and sends nothing new. Conversation-mode campaigns and the quiet trigger stay on the outbox.

DONE 2026-11-18 (switch off): code, tests and the activation gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md ("Campaign broadcasts"). Turning it on needs a Full-access RESEND_API_KEY and contact.updated added to the Resend webhook.

verify.note: Passes while the campaign send can go out as one broadcast after the send gate and Resend opt-outs sync back as root-Space suppressions.
